topic: Electrical Energy Generation in Wind Farm
key_concepts: Wind causes the Ariring or turbine blades to rotate
Changing electric fan speed changes the rotation of the Ariring
Changing distance from the wind source changes the rotation of the Ariring
The Ariring is a simple model of a wind turbine
The San Lorenzo Wind Farm is a 54 MW facility in San Lorenzo, Guimaras
Wind turbines have components that work together to generate electricity
Wind turbines convert wind energy into electrical energy
Wind speed affects the amount of energy available for conversion
Wind turbines require suitable wind conditions to operate efficiently
Wind farms can have impacts on the local community and biodiversity
